load_faiss_index: load a FAISS index from disk with optional GPU transfer and nprobe configuration
transfer_index_to_gpu: transfer a FAISS index to all available GPUs with optional fp16 and shard settings
compute_knn_distances: perform batched kNN search on query embeddings against a FAISS index and return distances and indices
save_distances_to_disk: save kNN search distances and indices as numpy arrays to disk in fp16 or fp32 format
review_compute_distances: review the compute_distances function for batched kNN search with mmap-based embedding loading
